children.name: Grevea bosseri Letouzey
children.description: The native range of this species is Liberia, Congo. It grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Grevea eggelingii Milne-Redh.
children.description: The native range of this species is E. Tanzania. It is a shrub or tree and grows primarily in the seasonally dry tropical biome.

children.name: Grevea madagascariensis Baill.
children.description: The native range of this species is Madagascar. It is a shrub and grows primarily in the seasonally dry tropical biome.

children.name: Kaliphora madagascariensis Hook.fil.
children.description: The native range of this species is SC. Madagascar. It is a shrub or tree and grows primarily in the seasonally dry tropical biome.

children.name: Montinia caryophyllacea Thunb.
children.description: The native range of this species is SW. Angola to Cape Prov. and SW. Botswana. It is a shrub and grows primarily in the desert or dry shrubland biome.
